One beautiful handmade candle to take home (and show off, of course).

blurb: Looking for a fun thing to do in Atlanta that isn’t just another dinner reservation or crowded bar? This hands-on candle making class hosted at a trendy local wine bar with Instructor Charvi is a relaxed, feel-good way to slow down, get creative and make something you’ll want to take home. Perfect for both locals craving a fresh night out and travelers looking for a memorable experience in Atlanta, this beginner-friendly class brings together cozy vibes, custom scents and plenty of laughs. You’ll choose your fragrance blend, learn the basics of wax and wicks and pour your own custom candle from start to finish. Whether you’re planning a date night, solo self-care moment, girls’ night out or creative group activity, this candle making experience gives you a break from the daily stress and sends you home with a handmade souvenir that smells like your best decision of the week.
